TYPE-DISCIPLINE ADDENDUM to post-01M19QRV4N3BH0VE7S18W9C8XB.

A diff-scoped public-boundary audit found and repaired one adapter-level downgrade after that post: StoryAtlas warOfTheGhosts/assemble stringified NonEmptyChain[DomainError], and BundleDeliveryOutcome.toEither/write stringified BundleDeliveryFailure. They now preserve the typed errors; only Main renders them for terminal output. The Java unix:nlink boundary no longer uses asInstanceOf and pattern-checks Number.

Audit result: CLEAN after repair. No warning suppressions, unchecked matches, public casts, raw-string domain errors, sentinel states, broad maps, or stale matches over SourceOutcome/SemanticOutcome/TargetUniverse/BundleDeliveryOutcome. Validating roots remain final non-case classes with external-package compile probes against Mirror/copy; consequential choices remain typed. The only String error channel left in this slice is CLI argument syntax; the only null check is the Java Path.getParent boundary.

Post-repair CLI/scalafmt gate is 25/25 green and two fresh bundles remain byte-identical with unchanged BundleId 42068a686d5e328ad7ee7d3625bff059471848c915fe9cea5240b758e9780e87. Spec bytes/digest are unchanged at 7f675eab082443777289095ddd37c0ec3556ed968e43018d6cdf628d09f100bd.
